name: event-kinds-retire-unemitted
title: EVENT_KINDS 收口：退休从未发射的 cost / error 两条声明（票 5ao）
description: cost/error 两条 kind 自 P1a 起声明却从未有发射者（cost 落在 kind:llm 的 cost_usd，error 走 realtime WORKFLOW_ERROR + kind:node 的 status/error）。退休它们，让声明集等于发射端能产出的集合，并用测试钉住；同步 publish-action-protocol 已知残留。
creator: codex
notes: IMPLEMENTED 2026-10-31. Retired 'cost' and 'error' from EVENT_KINDS (13 -> 11). Emitting them would create a second truth for the same fact; the declaration now matches what writers produce. Docs: publish-action-protocol's 'known residual' bullet is closed with the canonical homes and the shape of this close-out (no claim value changed -- the claim event_kinds_readers_outside_its_defining_module stays 1). Mutations: re-adding 'cost' turned both new tests red; restored.
